purpose: Selected vehicle's independent Monday–Sunday digest: weekly driving, charging, battery-at-charge averages, alerts, supervised-driving evidence, previous-week comparisons and optional AI narration.
primaryGoal: Review available records for a selected week, compare the previous week, navigate weeks and recover individual failed sources without losing independent sections or specialist explanations.

dataSources.name: Digest orchestration and workspace vehicle
dataSources.behavior: Vehicle selection is consumed from the existing workspace hook; no local vehicle picker is mounted. Digest week navigation is an independent business period, not a second workspace range selector. Vehicle hook internals and vehicle-error rendering are not inspected.

dataSources.name: Driving history
dataSources.behavior: AbortSignal forwarded; vehicle-enabled query with safeArray selection and FAST stale time. Selected and previous weeks are filtered locally from a bounded history window; no claim of complete server results. Aggregates retain meters, seconds and Wh; chart conversion is display-only.

dataSources.name: Charging history
dataSources.behavior: AbortSignal forwarded; vehicle-enabled, safeArray, FAST stale time. One bounded page, not pagination through the entire result. Cost sums cost_decimal; energy is Wh, power is W, duration fallback uses timestamps; SOC averages are charge-session averages, not live battery state.

dataSources.name: Alert history
dataSources.behavior: Global bounded history query, AbortSignal, MODERATE stale time and safeArray. Client filtering retains alerts within the selected week for the chosen vehicle plus vehicle_id=0. No server week/vehicle bounds or result-completeness proof.

dataSources.name: Supervised-driving evidence
dataSources.endpoint: GET /analytics/fsd (scoped start/end, vehicle and browser timezone)
dataSources.behavior: Historical query policy, AbortSignal and required vehicle/start/end enablement. Scope builder implementation is not inspected. FSD panel reads cumulative counter changes, nullable distance/share and previous-week changes; it explicitly states absence is not zero and engagement is not exact.

dataSources.name: Current-week browser notification
dataSources.behavior: Only current week, ready FSD evidence, existing permission and measured distance. Skips subscribed push devices; deduplicates via teslasync.fsd.weeklyDigest.notified.<vehicle>.<local-week-date>. Notification click navigates /weekly-digest; never prompts for permission here.

dataSources.name: Opt-in Helix narration
dataSources.behavior: Feature-gated by withAiFeature('digest-narration'); canonical deterministic digest remains independent. Positive finite vehicle enables generation. Body currently fixes week_offset_weeks=0; stream identity includes vehicle only. Handler documents the endpoint and router supplies Digest to guarded AI mounting; exact delegated route registration, stream transport and backend filtering were not inspected.

components.name: PageLayout / CardGrid / Section
components.notes: Six grids, two semantic sections, stable item IDs, full/half allocations; no replacement layout needed. Shared implementation not audited.

components.name: FadeIn
components.notes: Seven entrance wrappers with staggered delays. Reduced-motion implementation and rendered behavior unverified.

components.name: WeekNavigation
components.notes: Existing LayoutCard, Badge, Button, Text; wrapping labels and explicit minimum 44px controls. Preserve Next disabled in the current week.

components.name: DigestOperationalSummary / FsdOperationalPanel
components.notes: Reuse OperationalBrief and useOperationalMetrics; retain explicit source availability and specialist useUnits/useFormatting/useNumberFormatting callbacks, missing baseline explanations and links.

components.name: DrivingPanel / ChargingPanel
components.notes: Existing ChartCard, StatGroup, chart barrel, ChartTooltip, palette/axes/grid/motion; dataColumns supplied for source-backed alternatives. Both keep detail footers separate from plot state.

components.name: BatteryPanel / BatteryPill / AlertsPanel
components.notes: Reuse LayoutCard, GlassPanel, StatGroup, feedback, semantic Badge and EmbeddedChart. Battery meter keeps rounded text, clamped geometry and explicit accessible value. Alerts retain severity list and pie/table data.

components.name: AIDigestNarration / AIFeatureCard
components.kind: existing shared AI surface and page-specific feature
components.notes: Existing feature gate, streaming output scaffold, disabled/busy button and vehicle hint; no replacement AI card. AiOutputPanel and gate internals were not inspected.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Summary and comparison already share DigestOperationalSummary; four domain sources already share retry/loading/error prop shapes. Repeated wiring is orchestration, not evidence that another card or query-state engine is necessary.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep the existing domain adapters and shared OperationalBrief/ChartCard/StatGroup; standardize trust propagation without duplicating rendering or changing specialist formatting.

issues.detail: Battery labels are truncated while a fixed-width meter competes for row width. Long localized labels may lose visible information; actual clipping has not been exercised.
issues.fix: Allow label wrapping or an existing accessible disclosure while preserving the meter and full label; test 320px, enlarged text and long translations.

states.initialLoading: Per-domain busy flags also include vehiclesLoading (useWeeklyDigest.ts:172-175). Summary suppresses loading metrics only when both source availability flags are absent; FSD suppresses initial values without insights. Battery/alerts use Skeleton, charts receive loading. Detail footer values are constructed separately, creating the unknown-zero issue below.
states.empty: Driving and charging use positive chart bins for empty plots; top-drive absence links /drives; battery no-session state links /charging; resolved zero alerts have a dedicated message. FSD missing distance has an explanation and /fsd?days=7 action. Summary currently shows returned-record status for a resolved empty array.
states.error: Independent retries flow from page to domain components. Summary and FSD preserve available metrics beside QueryError. Battery/alerts replace retained content on errors; chart-frame retained rendering not inspected.
states.staleOfflinePartial: PageLayout receives four complete freshness query objects and localized source identities, while most child panels receive only loading/error booleans, not explicit freshness/offline/partial state. Shared layout behavior is unverified.
states.disabled: Next is disabled for current week; narration is disabled without a positive finite vehicle or while streaming.

issues.rule: MDC-026 retained data survives refresh failure
issues.detail: Any isError replaces the battery evidence with QueryError even if charging data and computed metrics remain cached. AlertsPanel.tsx:60 similarly replaces severity rows and chart. Page passes raw query errors at WeeklyDigestPage.tsx:248-266 without fatal/refresh distinction.
issues.fix: Adapt existing query/data-trust state to distinguish no-payload fatal failure from refresh failure; keep cached battery/alerts evidence, show refresh warning and retry, and preserve independent neighbors.

issues.rule: MDC-026 / MDC-045 unknown is not zero
issues.detail: averagePresent returns zero with no measurements; efficiencyWhPerM and chargingPowerW also return zero for unavailable measurements. SOC aggregation at lines 284-285 and BatteryPanel.tsx:36,55-64 can therefore show measured-looking 0% for sessions with missing SOC. DrivingPanel.tsx:58-95 and ChargingPanel.tsx:57-85 format default-zero details even before source resolution; object/array availability alone cannot prove individual fields.
issues.fix: Keep raw SI payloads, calculations for known values and true zero counts, but retain field-level missingness and source availability in derived presentation. Suppress initial unavailable detail measurements and display existing unknown/unavailable states rather than fabricated zero.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-012 / mission 43 restrained theme-aware semantic color
visualIssues.detail: Highlight trends always use emerald-300/rose-300, while non-highlight trends already use light/dark variants. DrivingPanel.tsx:81-82 and FsdOperationalPanel.tsx:36-43 also fix pale semantic icon colors; AlertsPanel.tsx:26-28 fixes severity icon colors. These are source-level theme/visual-noise risks, not measured contrast failures.
visualIssues.fix: Use the existing semantic token/severity owner or existing light/dark treatment consistently; preserve favorable/unfavorable meaning and non-color cues. Measure actual composed contrast in both themes.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / mission 43 avoid ornamental saturated emphasis
visualIssues.detail: Shared Helix action applies its own cyan borders, tinted backgrounds, text, hover colors and focus ring instead of only the canonical outline treatment. Its badge also uses cyan styling at line 214. Flag for owner review of cumulative accent noise; no neon/glow or measured saturation failure is established.
visualIssues.fix: Existing AI shared owner should assess neutral outline/control tokens with restrained branded semantic accent, retaining all labels, gate, disabled/busy states and focus visibility. Do not add page-local overrides or reset user palettes.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-032 / MDC-045 preserve actual selected period
architectureIssues.detail: Page passes vehicleId only at WeeklyDigestPage.tsx:306 while navigation changes the digest week. Narration always posts week_offset_weeks=0 and its scopeKey at line 64 contains only vehicle, so historical-week narration does not share the displayed week or reset when that week changes.
architectureIssues.fix: Existing AI feature owner should accept the selected digest offset/period from the original digest hook and include vehicle plus week in stream identity. Preserve explicit user-triggered generation, the default current-week behavior, gate and cancellation. Inspect server week semantics before implementation.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-033 / MDC-044 retain raw numeric input; format only at display boundary
architectureIssues.detail: useWeeklyDigest.ts:356 returns funFact.times already localized by fmtNumber; summary reparses it with Number(funFact.times). Decimal comma/grouped text can yield NaN and fail shared numeric validation even though the text formatter would display the original string.
architectureIssues.fix: Carry the raw dimensionless ratio alongside localized presentation, feed raw numeric data to the existing multiplier metric and preserve original city-pair description, formatting and threshold. Do not parse localized display text.

architectureIssues.detail: Mounted domain panels bypass canonical layout/data-display barrels for layout-reference/stat-reference imports. ChargingPanel.tsx:4-5, BatteryPanel.tsx:3-4, AlertsPanel.tsx:3 and WeekNavigation.tsx:3 repeat this. presentation.ts:2 also bypasses the data-display barrel for StatMetric.
architectureIssues.fix: Import the existing identical owners through '@/components/layout' and '@/components/data-display' in feature callers; do not create replacement wrappers or alter shared component internals.

architectureIssues.detail: presentedMetric converts every specialist measurement to metricId='text' with an already formatted string. This preserves legacy display but bypasses raw numeric validation/missingness for domain stats, unlike the page's OperationalBrief adapters.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse accepted StatMetric formatter support where equivalence is established; carry raw SI and missingness with display-only existing specialist formatters. KEEP specialist output where generic precision/unit equivalence is unproved.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-026 bounded results cannot establish complete/healthy weekly evidence
architectureIssues.detail: Alert history requests 1000 global records without week/vehicle bounds, then filters locally. Older or busy-fleet weeks can lack visible records despite successful query resolution. AlertsPanel.tsx:65 says 'everything looks great' for zero returned alerts; drive/charge requests are also bounded. Actual server caps/order and completeness are unverified.
architectureIssues.fix: Retain current period provenance and distinguish bounded absence from verified zero; integration owner should inspect server support before adding full-window pagination/filtering. Never fabricate a completeness guarantee or filter only a loaded page and call it complete.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-044 localized labels without recasing source identities
architectureIssues.detail: DAY_LABELS supplies hardcoded Mon–Sun to daily chart axes/data rows. AlertsPanel.tsx:91 displays raw severity; useWeeklyDigest.ts:343 capitalizes severity into pie labels rather than deriving a localized presentation label. FsdOperationalPanel.tsx:44 hardcodes the display unit 'pts'.
architectureIssues.fix: Localize presentation weekday/severity/percentage-point labels through existing canonical catalogs and locale formatters while preserving Monday-first order, severity keys, grouping, colors, source identity and raw percentage-point values.

priority.rationale: Fix selected-week narration mismatch, missing-measurement/retained-data trust and localized multiplier parsing before cosmetic adoption. P2: canonical imports/numeric stats, localized labels and bounded-result honesty. P3: theme-aware accent refinement and responsive review.
